Public domain: every person whose words are in this text died in 1925 or earlier, so the term has ended under the law of every country, whichever one first published it.

People: Thomas Hood (author, Wikidata Q722533), died 1845; Frances Freeling Broderip (editor, Wikidata Q5478655), died 1878; Tom Hood (editor, Wikidata Q1270673), died 1874. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Hood, Thomas, 1799-1845; Broderip, Frances Freeling, 1830-1878 [Editor]; Hood, Tom, 1835-1874 [Editor]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: The Works Of Thomas Hood  Vol. 2, 1870, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/in.ernet.dli.2015.502875. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 70%, 86%, 73% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Frances Freeling Broderip, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
